name: Team Deathmatch
description: First team to 50 kills, or most kills after 10 minutes.

name: Air Domination
description: Capture 3 zones by flying below 300 m over them; held zones drain enemy tickets.

name: Ground Strike
description: Destroy the enemy's AI convoys, bunkers and ships.

name: Bomber Escort
description: One team protects AI bombers flying a route; the other intercepts them.
